noah: Heads-up: discovered a tiny but nasty difference between dev vs prod bundles when consuming the JS SDK in several bundlers. Dev server works; prod build fails with either `createClient is not a function` or `ReferenceError: global is not defined` on edge. Repro below.

noah: Minimal repro (Rollup/Vite/Webpack variants):
- create a ts app, install @redwood/inference-sdk
- `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk'`
- build for prod (rollup -c OR vite build --ssr OR webpack --mode=production)
- run bundle in node/edge; observe failures

noah: In one Rollup output I found an auto-generated wrapper: `module.exports = require('./cjs')` at top-level in the published package, which causes named export shapes to differ after optimization. In Vite SSR build we saw `var B = require('buffer').Buffer;` hoisted even though original source guarded it, leading to `global` references in edge.

ivy: Can you paste the snippet?

noah: rollup-optimized bundle fragment:
```js
// from node_modules/@redwood/inference-sdk/dist/index.js
module.exports = require('./cjs/index.js');
```
and vite bundle snippet:
```js
var B = require('buffer').Buffer; // appears only in production bundle
export { B as Buffer };
```

frida: This is classic entry-resolution + commonjs hoisting problem. Two vectors: (1) publishing a top-level CJS wrapper or missing `exports` makes bundlers pick CJS for prod optimizations; (2) commonjs plugin heuristics hoist guarded requires.

dena: Short fixes that worked for us in repro: (A) publish package with explicit `exports` entries including a pure-ESM `./edge` and `browser` subpath; (B) add root `types` and per-export `types` so tsc doesn't fallback to CJS path; (C) for immediate local fixes, pin bundler resolve: `webpack: resolve.mainFields=['module','main']`, `vite: ssr.noExternal=['@redwood/inference-sdk']`, or alias `buffer`->`./shims/empty-buffer.js`.

noah: Also note: changing imports to default import `import sdk from '@redwood/inference-sdk'` then using `sdk.createClient()` is an awkward but effective temporary workaround for consumers.

deps-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-813: add CI prod-bundle smoke test (vite/webpack/rollup) + publish canary with exports/types fixes.

ivy: I'll update the sample-app quickstart to run a production build in CI so we catch this. We should also add a short "Bundler gotchas" note in DX docs listing: exports map, type:module, ssr.noExternal, and buffer alias.

frida: Agreed. I'll push a canary with `exports` {"import","require","browser","./edge"} and include `dist/types/index.d.ts` at root. Will ping when published.

noah: Thanks — attaching repro repo link and failing bundle snippets to DEVEX-813. Will re-test once canary is out. :+1:
